test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A works 5.4 times as fast as B, and A takes 22 days less than B to complete the job when each works alone. Calculate the number of days taken to complete the same job if A and B work together.
solution:
Given: 

A works 5.4 times as fast as B, and A takes 22 days less than B to complete the job when each works alone. 

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Time ratio of A : B = 1 : 5.4

Time ratio of A : B = 5 : 27

So A takes 5x days B takes 27x days 

As per the question,

27x - 5x = 22

⇒ x = 1

So A takes 5 days and B takes 27 days 

So they together take,

⇒ (27 × 5) / 32 = 4(7)/(32)days

∴ The correct option is 3
